app.title: Commander Ayaan
app.parent_open_question: What do you think would happen if the Sun pulled less?
app.parent_closing_reflection: Tell someone one thing you learned today!
app.rest_message: You explored for 15 minutes. Tell someone one thing you learned!

parade.title: Planet Parade
parade.instruction: Put planets in order from the Sun!
parade.r3_prompt: Who lives in this empty spot?
parade.mission_complete: Mission Complete! You earned three stars!

sun.name: Sun
sun.fact1: The Sun is a star. Over one million Earths fit inside!
sun.fact2: The Sun holds almost all mass in our solar system!

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.fact1: Mercury is the smallest planet and closest to the Sun!
mercury.fact2: A year on Mercury is only eighty-eight Earth days!

venus.name: Venus
venus.fact1: Venus spins backwards compared to most other planets!
venus.fact2: Venus is the hottest planet because thick air traps heat!

earth.name: Earth
earth.fact1: Earth is our home and the only known place with life!
earth.fact2: Earth has one Moon that travels around it every month!

mars.name: Mars
mars.fact1: Mars looks red because of rusty iron dust on its ground!
mars.fact2: Mars has the biggest volcano in the whole solar system!

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.fact1: Jupiter is the biggest planet of all!
jupiter.fact2: Jupiter has a giant red storm that has raged for centuries!

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.fact1: Saturn has huge, bright rings made of ice and rock!
saturn.fact2: Saturn is so light it could float in water!

uranus.name: Uranus
uranus.fact1: Uranus rolls on its side as it circles the Sun!
uranus.fact2: Uranus is a giant ice ball with faint rings!

neptune.name: Neptune
neptune.fact1: Neptune is the farthest planet from the Sun!
neptune.fact2: Neptune is deep blue and has the fastest winds!
